info.headline: Orange Alert: Severe Cyclone Approaching North Coastal Andhra Pradesh near Visakhapatnam
info.description: Cyclonic storm system tracking northwestward with gale wind speeds reaching 90-110 kmph over Visakhapatnam and Vizianagaram. Extensive uprooting of power poles and damage to thatched huts expected.
info.instruction: Secure outdoor objects and stay inside sturdy shelters. Fishermen must not venture into the sea. Stock necessary food, medicines, and power banks.
